summary: NfcCoordinator's single-thread executor is never shut down; `MainViewModel` has no `onCleared()` override to release it.
claim: NfcCoordinator's single-thread executor is never shut down; `MainViewModel` has no `onCleared()` override to release it.

evidence.source: NfcCoordinator (NfcCoordinator.kt) creates `io = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()` with no exposed shutdown method; MainViewModel.kt defines no `onCleared()` override.

suggested_validation: Instrumented test confirming background thread count returns to baseline after the ViewModel is cleared.
reviewer_confidence: MEDIUM — leak mechanics are standard, but real-world severity in this single-Activity app is minor.
